notes_for_editor: Name, coordinates and map sheet agree across three sources. Elevation differs: 840 on the tnlandforms list (unit not stated) against 836 ft MSL on TopoQuest; the record's 256.0 m matches the list read as feet. The tnlandforms entry has no BLL or gfc tag, so no Georgia Forestry Commission coordinate note applies. No build, staffing, fire, status or access source found after two searches and about five page reads. The cached USGS GNIS names file has Jasper place names but no tower of this name. The status field should stay unknown until someone checks the site or a local source.
